Usage: runic-create [name] [options]

Create a Runic application. Asks for each option you do not pass.

Commands:
  completion <shell>  Generate bash, zsh, fish or PowerShell completions

Arguments:
  name  Project name and default directory.

Options:
  --output, -o <PATH>          Create the project in this directory instead, as dotnet new --output
                               does.
  --frontend <frontend>        Frontend framework.
  --package-manager <package-manager>
                               JavaScript package manager.
  --host <host>                Window host: desktop opens a native window, cswebui opens a browser
                               window.
  --linux-gtk <linux-gtk>      GTK version of Runic Desktop on Linux: 3 or 4.
  --view-models <view-models>  MVVM library for the C# ViewModels.
  --tests                      Add a TUnit test project for the Window. [default: False]
  --nix                        Add a Nix flake that builds the application with the Runic SDK's
                               builder. [default: False]
  --packaging                  Add packaging recipes: MSIX on Windows, a signed .app and disk image
                               on macOS, a Flatpak on Linux. [default: False]
  --yes, -y                    Use the default for every option you do not pass instead of asking.
                               [default: False]
  --dry-run                    Print the commands without running them. [default: False]
  --template-source <SOURCE>   An additional NuGet source for the template package.
  -h, --help                   Show help
  --version                    Show version
  --format <human|json>        Select output format

Examples:
  dnx Runic.Create
  dnx Runic.Create -- MyApp --frontend svelte --package-manager bun
  dnx Runic.Create -- MyApp --host cswebui --view-models toolkit
  dnx Runic.Create -- MyApp --yes --dry-run
  dnx Runic.Create -- MyApp -o apps/MyApp --yes

Creating completion (React · npm · Runic Desktop · GTK 3 · ReactiveUI)
The template "Runic application" was created successfully.

Created completion in completion.

Next:
  cd completion
  dotnet tool restore
  dotnet runic dev

Create the same project again without questions:
  dnx Runic.Create@0.9.1 -- completion --frontend react --package-manager npm --host desktop --linux-gtk 3 --view-models reactiveui
or with dotnet new:
  dotnet new install Runic.Application.Templates@0.9.1
  dotnet new runic-app --name completion --frontend react --package-manager npm --host desktop --linux-gtk 3 --view-models reactiveui
